name: mototaxi
description: MotoJá — app de mototáxi para Carmo, RJ (protótipo React)

scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name motoja --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:legacy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name mototaxi --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:pages: wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name motoja --branch main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply mototaxi-db --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply mototaxi-db --local --config worker/wrangler.toml
